name: dolphie
description: Feature-rich top tool for monitoring MySQL

repo.name: dolphie
repo.description: Your single pane of glass for real-time analytics into MySQL/MariaDB & ProxySQL

readme.summary: Excellent installation and configuration coverage, but lacks practical usage examples and troubleshooting guidance beyond the raw CLI reference.
readme.top_issue: No quick-start example showing a basic connection command in action — the usage section is a raw option dump with no walkthrough of common workflows.

injection_risks.description: Potential SQL injection risk through user input in hostgroup_hosts dictionary
User input is used to construct a command for the connect_as_hostgroup function, potentially allowing command injection

critical_findings: Potential SQL injection risk through user input in hostgroup_hosts dictionary
Lack of validation on user input in hostgroup_hosts dictionary
security.summary: The Dolphie application has some security concerns, including potential SQL injection risks and lack of input validation, but overall it appears to be a relatively secure application.

common_complaints: Version upgrade regressions (critical launch failures, missing dependencies)
CPU consumption when session closes abnormally
praise_themes: Core functionality works when properly configured
sentiment.summary: Project is actively maintained with good issue closure rates, but recent versions have introduced regressions and dependency issues that frustrate users during upgrades, with permission requirements limiting accessibility for smaller deployments.

communication.summary: The maintainer's responses are generally helpful, clear, and patient, providing a positive experience for users and contributors.

concerns: No active contributors in past 6 months

Unknown last release - no visible release cadence
One open issue with no closed issues in 6 months indicates unaddressed problems
Zero merged PRs in past 6 months shows no development activity
positive_signals: Very recent commit timestamp (2026-03-14), though isolated
maintenance.summary: This project is effectively abandoned with no active maintainers, zero development activity over 6 months, and unresolved issues.
